content: 31 assets: 10 Canadian equities; 10 U.S. equities; 9 ETFs (equity; bond; gold; ESG-screened); Bitcoin and Ether
source: Compiled by organizers; sector labels follow GICS sector names
limitations: Sector labels are organizer-assigned and simplified; ETF 'sector' describes exposure; not an official classification
terms_of_use: Free to use within the datathon

content: Daily OHLC; close; adjusted close; volume
source: Yahoo Finance via the open-source yfinance Python library
frequency: daily (trading days per market; crypto 7 days/week)
processing: No forward-fill; no calendar alignment; rows only on days Yahoo reports a price; prices in the asset's listing currency
limitations: adj_close is back-adjusted for splits and dividends so values shift when data is re-downloaded; crypto rows are UTC calendar days; Yahoo data is not exchange-certified

content: Dividends and stock splits by ex-date
processing: Extracted from the same download as prices
limitations: Dividend amounts are per share in listing currency; may be incomplete for ETFs

content: USD/CAD daily exchange rate and its inverse
source: Bank of Canada Valet API series FXUSDCAD
limitations: Single daily rate published around 16:30 ET; no rate on Canadian holidays

content: Bank of Canada policy rate; GoC 2y and 10y yields; Canada CPI y/y
source: Bank of Canada Valet API (V39079; BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD; BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD; STATIC_TOTALCPICHANGE)
processing: Long format; one row per (date; series_id)
limitations: Monthly CPI is dated to the reference month and is published several weeks later; do not use before its release date

content: U.S. fed funds rate; Treasury 2y and 10y yields; CPI; unemployment rate
source: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis): DFF; DGS2; DGS10; CPIAUCSL; UNRATE
limitations: Monthly series are dated to the reference month and released weeks later; values are latest vintage (revised) not as first published
terms_of_use: Original sources are U.S. government agencies (Federal Reserve Board; BLS); see FRED terms https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/
